#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independently verify the fixture-error evidence packet without running its checks."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/native-analytic-frames/shardloom-local-repo")
OUT = Path("/Users/dylan/LocalData/shardloom/required-execution-resources-20261010")
PACKET = ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-fixture-errors-2026-10-11.json"
INDEX = ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.json"
HEAD = "ea2265efb6d18a9692d5fe5cf1f013b42e3f61f5"
REPORT = OUT / "fixture-error-independent-279-report.json"


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read(path: Path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def git(*args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()


def source_hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
    names = git("ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z").split("\0")
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(set(names)):
        path = ROOT / name
        if name and path.is_file() and (
            name.endswith((".rs", ".py"))
            or path.name in ("Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock")
            or name.startswith("vendor/")
        ):
            result[name] = sha(path)
    return result


def source_identity(sources: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(sources, sort_keys=True).encode()
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def check(condition: bool, message: str, failures: list[str]) -> None:
    if not condition:
        failures.append(message)


def receipt_record(path: Path, expected_status: str | None, failures: list[str]) -> dict:
    record = read(path)
    check(record.get("head") == HEAD, f"receipt head mismatch: {path.name}", failures)
    if expected_status:
        check(record.get("status") == expected_status, f"receipt status mismatch: {path.name}", failures)
    check(
        (record.get("returncode") == 0) == (record.get("status") == "passed"),
        f"receipt status/returncode mismatch: {path.name}",
        failures,
    )
    check(record.get("direct_child_reaped") is True, f"child not reaped: {path.name}", failures)
    check(record.get("process_group_drained") is True, f"process group not drained: {path.name}", failures)
    log_path = path.with_suffix(".log")
    log_hash = sha(log_path)
    check(record.get("log_sha256") == log_hash, f"log hash mismatch: {log_path.name}", failures)
    return {"receipt": record, "log_path": str(log_path), "log_sha256": log_hash, "log_text": log_path.read_text()}


def main() -> int:
    failures: list[str] = []
    packet = read(PACKET)
    packet_hash = sha(PACKET)
    index = read(INDEX)
    link = index.get("fixture_error_review_correction", {})
    check(git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == HEAD, "unexpected HEAD", failures)
    check(packet.get("reviewed_head") == HEAD, "packet reviewed_head mismatch", failures)
    check(link.get("path") == PACKET.name, "evidence-index path mismatch", failures)
    check(link.get("sha256") == packet_hash, "evidence-index packet SHA mismatch", failures)
    check(packet.get("review_comment_ids") == [4240436097], "review comment mismatch", failures)
    generator = packet.get("generator", {})
    generator_path = Path(generator.get("path", ""))
    check(generator_path.is_file(), "packet generator file missing", failures)
    if generator_path.is_file():
        check(sha(generator_path) == generator.get("sha256"), "packet generator hash mismatch", failures)
        check(generator_path.read_text() == generator.get("text"), "embedded generator text mismatch", failures)

    current_sources = source_hashes()
    check(len(packet["source_hashes"]) == 1042, "packet source count is not 1042", failures)
    check(current_sources == packet["source_hashes"], "current source hashes differ from packet", failures)
    identity = source_identity(current_sources)
    check(identity == packet.get("source_identity_sha256"), "packet source identity mismatch", failures)
    check(packet.get("protocol", {}).get("source_hashes") == current_sources, "protocol source hashes mismatch", failures)
    check(packet.get("protocol", {}).get("source_identity_sha256") == identity, "protocol identity mismatch", failures)

    changed = packet.get("changed_files", {})
    before_after = {}
    for name, entry in changed.items():
        before = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{HEAD}:{name}"], cwd=ROOT)
        before_hash = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
        after_hash = sha(ROOT / name)
        check(entry.get("before_sha256") == before_hash, f"original HEAD hash mismatch: {name}", failures)
        check(entry.get("after_sha256") == after_hash, f"current file hash mismatch: {name}", failures)
        before_after[name] = {"before_sha256": before_hash, "after_sha256": after_hash}
    exact_diff = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", HEAD, "--", *changed], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    check(exact_diff == packet.get("source_patch"), "embedded source patch differs from current exact diff", failures)
    actual_diff_names = set(git("diff", "--name-only", HEAD).splitlines())
    omitted_diff_names = sorted(actual_diff_names - set(changed))
    expected_meta_path = str(INDEX.relative_to(ROOT))
    check(omitted_diff_names == [expected_meta_path], "unexpected files omitted from packet source patch", failures)
    meta_head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{HEAD}:{expected_meta_path}"], cwd=ROOT)
    meta_diff = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", HEAD, "--", expected_meta_path], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    untracked_packet = PACKET.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    untracked_names = set(git("ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    check(untracked_packet in untracked_names, "new packet is not the expected untracked evidence artifact", failures)
    runtime = sorted(name for name in changed if name in current_sources)
    check(runtime == packet.get("runtime_changed_files"), "runtime changed-file list mismatch", failures)
    check(len(runtime) == 5 and all(name.startswith("shardloom-cli/") for name in runtime), "runtime scope is not the five CLI files", failures)

    protocol = packet["protocol"]
    results = packet["results"]
    check(len(packet.get("checks", [])) == 14, "fresh source check count is not 14", failures)
    check(len(protocol.get("commands", {})) == 14, "protocol command count is not 14", failures)
    check(len(results.get("checks", [])) == 14, "result receipt count is not 14", failures)
    check(results.get("status") == "passed", "fresh results status is not passed", failures)
    protocol_path = OUT / "resource-engine-25-protocol.json"
    check(results.get("protocol_sha256") == sha(protocol_path), "results/protocol hash mismatch", failures)
    for item in packet["checks"]:
        receipt_path = Path(item["path"])
        inspected = receipt_record(receipt_path, "passed", failures)
        check(sha(receipt_path) == item.get("sha256"), f"receipt file hash mismatch: {receipt_path.name}", failures)
        check(item["receipt"] == inspected["receipt"], f"embedded receipt differs: {receipt_path.name}", failures)
        check(item["log"]["sha256"] == inspected["log_sha256"], f"embedded log hash mismatch: {receipt_path.name}", failures)
        check(item["log"]["text"] == inspected["log_text"], f"embedded log differs: {receipt_path.name}", failures)
        check(item["receipt"].get("command") == protocol["commands"].get(item["name"]), f"command mismatch: {item['name']}", failures)
        totals = item.get("rust_test_totals")
        if totals is not None:
            rows = re.findall(r"test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;", inspected["log_text"])
            observed = {key: sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i, key in enumerate(("passed", "failed", "ignored"))}
            check(totals == observed, f"test totals mismatch: {item['name']}", failures)
            check(observed["passed"] > 0 and observed["failed"] == 0, f"non-passing test totals: {item['name']}", failures)

    spill_item = packet["synthetic_spill_cli_suite"]
    spill_path = Path(spill_item["path"])
    spill = receipt_record(spill_path, "passed", failures)
    check(sha(spill_path) == spill_item.get("sha256"), "spill suite receipt hash mismatch", failures)
    check(spill_item["receipt"] == spill["receipt"], "embedded spill receipt differs", failures)
    check(spill_item["log"]["sha256"] == spill["log_sha256"], "spill log hash mismatch", failures)
    check(spill_item["log"]["text"] == spill["log_text"], "embedded spill log differs", failures)
    check("spill-payload-fs" in " ".join(spill["receipt"].get("command", [])), "spill feature absent from focused command", failures)
    check(re.findall(r"test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;", spill["log_text"]) == [("8", "0", "0")], "spill suite totals differ from 8/0/0", failures)
    regressions = packet.get("verified_regressions", [])
    check(regressions == ["admitted_fixture_parse_and_runtime_errors_retain_live_workspace_evidence", "admitted_spill_constructor_errors_report_zero_io_without_creating_a_workspace"], "regression names mismatch", failures)
    for test in regressions:
        check(f"test {test} ... ok" in spill["log_text"], f"spill log lacks passing regression {test}", failures)

    test_source_path = ROOT / "shardloom-cli/tests/required_execution_resources.rs"
    test_source = test_source_path.read_text()
    def test_block(name: str) -> str:
        start = test_source.index(f"fn {name}()")
        end = test_source.find("\n#[test]", start)
        return test_source[start:end if end >= 0 else len(test_source)]
    fixture_block = test_block(regressions[0])
    spill_block = test_block(regressions[1])
    fixture_cases = re.findall(r"^        &(?:\[|\n)", fixture_block, re.MULTILINE)
    spill_cases = re.findall(r"^        &(?:\[|\n)", spill_block, re.MULTILINE)
    check(len(fixture_cases) == 16, f"fixture regression has {len(fixture_cases)} top-level cases, expected 16", failures)
    check(len(spill_cases) == 3, f"spill regression has {len(spill_cases)} top-level cases, expected 3", failures)
    check(packet.get("new_failure_cases") == 19, "packet failure-case total differs from 19", failures)

    support = packet.get("support", {})
    support_results = support.get("results", {})
    reports = support.get("reports", [])
    check(support_results.get("status") == "passed", "support record status is not passed", failures)
    check(len(support_results.get("reports", [])) == 14 and len(reports) == 14, "support records are not 14", failures)
    check(support_results.get("source_identity_sha256") == identity, "support source identity mismatch", failures)
    support_checks = []
    for item in reports:
        if "path" in item:
            path = Path(item["path"])
            actual = sha(path)
            check(actual == item.get("sha256"), f"support record hash mismatch: {path.name}", failures)
            check(any(source_item.get("path") == item["path"] and source_item.get("sha256") == item.get("sha256") for source_item in support_results.get("reports", [])), f"support result missing record {path.name}", failures)
            support_checks.append({"path": str(path), "sha256": actual})
        else:
            check(bool(item), "empty inline support record", failures)
            check(item in support_results.get("reports", []), "support result missing inline record", failures)
            support_checks.append({"inline_record": item})

    intermediate_results = {}
    statuses = []
    for name, item in packet.get("preserved_intermediate_checks", {}).items():
        receipt_path = Path(item["path"])
        inspected = receipt_record(receipt_path, None, failures)
        check(sha(receipt_path) == item.get("sha256"), f"intermediate receipt hash mismatch: {name}", failures)
        check(item["receipt"] == inspected["receipt"], f"intermediate receipt differs: {name}", failures)
        check(item["log"]["sha256"] == inspected["log_sha256"], f"intermediate log hash mismatch: {name}", failures)
        check(item["log"]["text"] == inspected["log_text"], f"intermediate log differs: {name}", failures)
        statuses.append(inspected["receipt"].get("status"))
        intermediate_results[name] = {"status": inspected["receipt"].get("status"), "command": inspected["receipt"].get("command"), "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt_path), "log_sha256": inspected["log_sha256"]}
    check(len(statuses) == 4 and statuses.count("failed") == 3 and statuses.count("passed") == 1, "intermediate status counts differ from 3 failed/1 passed", failures)

    prior_name = packet["unchanged_scope_evidence"]["path"]
    prior_path = ROOT / prior_name
    prior = read(prior_path)
    check(sha(prior_path) == packet["unchanged_scope_evidence"]["sha256"], "prior packet hash mismatch", failures)
    check(set(prior["source_hashes"]) == set(packet["source_hashes"]), "prior/current source path sets differ", failures)
    source_differences = sorted(name for name in current_sources if current_sources[name] != prior["source_hashes"][name])
    check(source_differences == runtime, "prior packet source differences are not exactly five CLI files", failures)

    preserved = packet.get("preserved_artifact_sha256", {})
    preserved_check = {}
    for name, expected in preserved.items():
        actual = sha(ROOT / name)
        check(actual == expected, f"preserved artifact hash mismatch: {name}", failures)
        preserved_check[name] = actual
    check(len(preserved) == 14, "prior artifact count is not 14", failures)

    check(packet.get("original_complete_workflows_rerun") is False, "complete workflows claimed rerun", failures)
    check(packet.get("performance_claim") is False, "performance claim is enabled", failures)
    check(packet.get("full43_runs") is None, "packet unexpectedly declares fresh Full43 runs", failures)
    current_commands = [" ".join(row["receipt"]["command"]) for row in packet.get("checks", [])]
    check(not any("full43" in command.lower() for command in current_commands), "fresh command list contains Full43 rerun", failures)
    check(not any("run_resource_acceptance" in command or "public_rows" in command for command in current_commands), "fresh command list contains complete public workflow rerun", failures)
    check(packet.get("whole_process_memory_limit_enforced") is False, "whole-process limit claim is enabled", failures)
    check(packet.get("fallback_attempted") is False and packet.get("external_engine_invoked") is False, "fallback/external engine flag not false", failures)
    check(packet.get("intermediate_checks_establish_final_source_acceptance") is False, "intermediate receipts overclaimed as final acceptance", failures)

    report = {
        "status": "passed" if not failures else "failed",
        "packet": str(PACKET),
        "packet_sha256": packet_hash,
        "head": HEAD,
        "source_count": len(current_sources),
        "source_identity_sha256": identity,
        "changed_file_hashes": before_after,
        "exact_patch_match": exact_diff == packet.get("source_patch"),
        "post_packet_index_link_change": {
            "path": expected_meta_path,
            "head_sha256": hashlib.sha256(meta_head).hexdigest(),
            "current_sha256": sha(INDEX),
            "diff": meta_diff,
            "packet_path_untracked": untracked_packet,
        },
        "fresh_check_count": len(packet.get("checks", [])),
        "fresh_check_commands_and_totals": [
            {"name": row["name"], "command": row["receipt"]["command"], "rust_test_totals": row.get("rust_test_totals")}
            for row in packet.get("checks", [])
        ],
        "spill_cli_command": spill["receipt"].get("command"),
        "spill_test_totals": {"passed": 8, "failed": 0, "ignored": 0},
        "regressions": regressions,
        "failure_case_counts": {"fixture_parse_and_runtime": len(fixture_cases), "spill_constructor": len(spill_cases)},
        "support_record_count": len(reports),
        "preserved_intermediate_checks": intermediate_results,
        "previous_source_differences": source_differences,
        "preserved_artifact_count": len(preserved_check),
        "original_complete_workflows_rerun": packet.get("original_complete_workflows_rerun"),
        "historical_full43_runs_in_reused_prior_evidence": packet.get("original_complete_workflow_evidence", {}).get("full43_runs"),
        "fresh_commands_contain_full43_or_complete_public_rerun": False,
        "performance_claim": packet.get("performance_claim"),
        "failures": failures,
    }
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"status": report["status"], "report": str(REPORT), "failures": failures}, indent=2))
    return 0 if not failures else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
